tools.name: analyze_document
tools.description: Analyze a document using Crucible™ Evidence Engine. Returns source-grounded findings with evidence, confidence, verification status, and routing metadata. Use specialized financial/contract tools when the domain is known.

params.name: query
params.description: Analysis question or focus area

params.name: format
params.description: Optional: Force a specific input format. Default: auto-detect via magic bytes.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Optional ticker/company symbol metadata for financial filing analysis.

params.name: content
params.description: Document content to analyze (max 20MB). Required unless fileUrl is provided. Accepts: (1) plain text, (2) Base64-encoded file with data URI prefix (e.g., "data:application/pdf;base64,..."), or (3) raw

params.name: fileUrl
params.description: Optional: HTTPS URL to download the document from. If provided, content field is ignored. Use text-extractable source documents. Max 20MB.

params.name: sourceType
params.description: Optional source type metadata for Crucible™ routing and output metadata.

params.name: analysisType
params.description: Optional Crucible™ analysis mode. Default: auto.

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: Optional contract jurisdiction metadata. Output remains evidence triage, not legal advice.

params.name: partyPerspective
params.description: Optional contract review perspective. Default: neutral.

tools.name: analyze_public_filing
tools.description: Crucible™ Financial Filing Intelligence for public filings and annual reports. Accepts content, filingUrl, or SEC ticker/CIK lookup for 10-K, 10-Q, and 20-F filings. Returns metrics, risk changes, contradictions, source evidence, confidence, and a not-investment-advice flag.

params.name: cik
params.description: SEC CIK. Optional alternative to ticker.

params.name: form
params.description: SEC filing form. Default: 10-K.

params.name: year
params.description: Filing or report year. Omit for latest matching filing.

params.name: depth
params.description: Analysis depth hint. Default: standard.

params.name: ticker
params.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL. Used to resolve SEC filings when content/filingUrl is omitted.

params.name: content
params.description: Uploaded or preprocessed filing text. Used before URL/ticker lookup when provided.

params.name: question
params.description: Optional focus question for the filing analysis.

params.name: filingUrl
params.description: Public filing/report URL. Used before ticker lookup when provided.

tools.name: review_contract_risks
tools.description: Crucible™ Contract Risk Intelligence for contracts, MSAs, NDAs, procurement agreements, and compliance documents. Extracts risk clauses, obligations, deadlines, liability exposure, missing terms, unusual clauses, evidence, and human-review flags. Not legal advice.

params.name: depth
params.description: Analysis depth hint. Default: standard.

params.name: focus
params.description: Optional focus area for the contract review.

params.name: query
params.description: Optional focus area. Default reviews payment, termination, liability, confidentiality, jurisdiction, renewal, obligations, deadlines, missing terms, and evidence.

params.name: format
params.description: Optional input format override. Default: auto.

params.name: content
params.description: Contract, MSA, NDA, procurement agreement, vendor agreement, compliance document, or Base64 file content. Required unless fileUrl is provided.

params.name: fileUrl
params.description: Optional HTTPS URL to a public contract/document file. Max 20MB.

params.name: sourceType
params.description: Optional source type metadata. Default: text or file_url.

params.name: contractType
params.description: Contract type hint. Default: other.

params.name: jurisdiction
params.description: Optional jurisdiction metadata. Output is evidence triage and not legal advice.

params.name: partyPerspective
params.description: Review perspective for risk triage. Default: neutral.

tools.name: extract_web
tools.description: Extract content from a web page URL, optionally analyzing it with the actor-critic pipeline. Works with static and server-rendered HTML pages.

params.name: url
params.description: Web page URL to extract content from

params.name: query
params.description: Optional analysis question to apply after extraction

tools.name: summarize
tools.description: Generate a concise summary with key points. Faster and cheaper than analyze_document — best for shorter documents.

params.name: content
params.description: Document text to summarize

params.name: max_length
params.description: Optional maximum summary length in words (default: 500)

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: FREE: Estimate the x402 USDC cost of any tool or multi-step workflow before paying. Use this before calling paid tools to check pricing.

params.name: tool
params.description: Tool name to estimate cost for (e.g. "analyze_document", "extract_web", "summarize")

params.name: depth
params.description: Workflow depth hint for filing/contract tools. Default: standard

params.name: query
params.description: Optional analysis query. Include it for exhaustive/high-output requests so the preview matches the x402 quote.

params.name: workflow
params.description: Optional list of tool names for a multi-step workflow. Returns total cost for the full pipeline.

params.name: input_source
params.description: Input source hint used to explain cache/download behavior

params.name: content_length
params.description: Approximate character count of your input document (used for LLM cost estimation)

params.name: content_sample
params.description: Optional short content excerpt for multilingual/high-output pricing hints without sending the full document.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: FREE: Check service health, engine availability, and uptime. Use before dispatching paid calls to confirm the service is operational.

params.name: verbose
params.description: If true, include detailed per-engine diagnostics (default: false)

tools.name: delegate_bulk_translate
tools.description: Translate all string values in a JSON object or array to any target language. Preserves JSON structure, keys, and non-string values. Auto-chunks large payloads. Ideal for i18n locale files.

params.name: json
params.description: JSON string (object or array) whose string values will be translated

params.name: preserve_keys
params.description: If true (default), object keys are left untranslated. Set false to also translate keys.

params.name: source_language
params.description: Source language (default: auto-detect). E.g. "English", "en"

params.name: target_language
params.description: Target language name or ISO 639-1 code (e.g. "Chinese", "zh", "Japanese", "ja", "fr")
